To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the RRCG WF for multiuser detection in code division multiple-access communication systems can be made to converge in one, two, or three steps for different code set, and that this number is determined by the eigenstructure of the code Grammian.

for signal modes that have specially structured data covariance matrices, the warp converging RRCG-Wiener filter can be used for MUD in code division multiple systems, where the convergence speed varies from 1-4 steps based on the spreading sequences used.
the number of convergence steps of RRCG-WFs for MUD in a CDMA system is exactly determined by the eigen-structure analysis of the code set.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the convergence properties of the RRCGs, which are of great practical importance for real-time implementation of MUD.
the design of spreading sequences to achieve the warp converging RRCG-WFs.
a new approach for MUD in a CDMA system, where a reduced-rank Wiener filter with a warp converging property is employed to estimate the desired signal.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RRCG algorithm is a powerful tool for MUD, and the warp convergence property is very desirable in practice.

for a set of spreading codes, the number of convergence steps of RRCG-WFs for multiuser detection in CDMA systems is determined by the eigen-structure (i.e., the eigenvalues) of the corresponding code set Grammians.
the spreading codes with the property that all the eigenvalues of the Grammian of the code set are equal are the most desirable spreading sequences for the MUD in the CDMA systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RRCG method can be applied to a large class of CDMA communication systems, including the systems using Walsh, Hadamard, Gold, and Kasami sequences.
the warp convergence of the RRCGWf for MUD in a CDMA system can be guaranteed for all the commonly used spreading sequences.

we have shown that for a given spreading sequence, the number of convergence steps of the RRCGWf is determined by the eigen-structure, and that the eigen-structure can be easily determined from the Grammian.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RRCG method is a very powerful tool for MUD in code division multiple-access systems.
, in order to achieve warp convergence using the RRCG algorithm, the code set Gramian needs to be of rank 1 or 2.
the RRCG WF can achieve warp convergence for a wide range of code sets.
